description: Combines 2–6 annotation files (Zero-Shot Annotation output and/or Smart Labeler annotations.json, in any mix) into one. Annotations for the same image are combined, e.g. two zero-shot runs on one folder with different prompts. The result feeds Annotations to YOLO Dataset or the Smart Labeler.

inputs.name: annotations_3
inputs.description: Optional: another annotation file, used only when wired.

inputs.name: annotations_4
inputs.description: Optional: another annotation file, used only when wired.

inputs.name: annotations_5
inputs.description: Optional: another annotation file, used only when wired.

inputs.name: annotations_6
inputs.description: Optional: another annotation file, used only when wired.

outputs.name: annotations
outputs.description: The combined annotations, in the format chosen in the settings.

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: Annotations and images per input file, the combined totals, and duplicates dropped.

output_format.description: Format of the combined file: zero-shot's flat format, or the Smart Labeler's annotations.json. Annotations to YOLO Dataset and the Smart Labeler read both.

dedupe_iou.description: Drop an annotation that overlaps a higher-scored one of the same class on the same image by at least this IoU (0–1), for files that found the same objects. 0 keeps everything; try 0.7.

prefix_folders.description: The files describe DIFFERENT image folders that Merge Folders combined with 'into subfolders' on: keys file N's images under folder_N/, to match. Wire annotations_N to the file for that step's folder_N.

exec_queue.description: Scheduler queue. This is a CPU-only job, so it defaults to a CPU queue (overrides the run-level queue).

appArgs.name: tool
appArgs.description: The shared wf-utils container runs several small tools; this picks which one (jobs/wf_utils/).
